
`<PROJECTKEY>-<TYPE>-<n>[#sec-<anchor>]`, matching `^([A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9})-(SPEC|ADR|PLAN)-(\d+)(#sec-.+)?$`. Examples: `WL-SPEC-77`, `WL-SPEC-77#sec-9`, `WL-PLAN-145`. `<n>` is an integer with no zero padding. Numbers draw from a per-`(project, kind)` counter, so a spec and a plan may share a number and `<TYPE>` selects. `lode doc add` allocates the next free number. An explicit `--number` is legal for reserving or importing and is collision-checked against the same counter. `<TYPE>` is verified against the target's kind. `SPEC`, `ADR` and `PLAN` are reserved project keys. `ADR` names a retired ADR and resolves to its successor spec (WL-SPEC-77#sec-7aa). A document reference must never parse as a task id. Bare task ids matching `[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}-\d+` in bodies autolink to the cockpit.
